name: Docking Autodock Vina
description: Performs molecular docking using AutoDock Vina to predict binding affinities between small molecules and a receptor protein.
detailed_description: Performs molecular docking using AutoDock Vina to predict binding affinities between small molecules and a receptor protein.
when_to_use: When you need docking autodock vina analysis

parameters.smiles_list: [Required] List of SMILES strings representing small molecules to dock (List[str])
parameters.receptor_pdb_file: [Required] Path to the receptor protein structure PDB file (str)
parameters.box_center: [Required] 3D coordinates [x, y, z] of the docking box center (List[float])
parameters.box_size: [Required] Dimensions [x, y, z] of the docking box (List[float])
parameters.ncpu: [Optional] Number of CPU cores to use for docking (default: 1)
